description: This file defines backbone modules for an object detection model, including custom BatchNorm, backbone classes, and a backbone builder function.

classes.name: FrozenBatchNorm2d
classes.description: A BatchNorm2d layer with fixed batch statistics and affine parameters.

classes.name: BackboneBase
classes.description: Base class for backbone with optional intermediate layer return.

classes.name: Backbone
classes.description: ResNet backbone with frozen BatchNorm, extending BackboneBase.

classes.name: Joiner
classes.description: Sequential module combining backbone and position embedding, outputs nested tensors and positional encodings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for FrozenBatchNorm2d, initializes buffers for fixed batch norm parameters.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Applies fixed BatchNorm to input tensor.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for BackboneBase, sets up backbone with optional intermediate layers.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Processes NestedTensor input through backbone, returns dict of NestedTensors.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for Backbone, creates ResNet backbone with optional dilation and frozen BatchNorm.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for Joiner, combines backbone and position encoding.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Processes NestedTensor through backbone and position encoder, returns list of NestedTensors and positional encodings.

methods.name: build_backbone
methods.description: Builds and returns a combined backbone and position encoding model based on args.
